title: the WSG proficiencies prose - the system frame, the choosing-skills rules and the twenty-five descriptions - THE WSG GAP CLOSURE ROUND
audit_comment: The wilderness proficiencies prose, printed pp. 11-17 (pdf 12-18): the DSG-system frame with the dual-environment ruling, the choosing-skills rules (the player chooses, the background logic, the DM approval) and all twenty-five descriptions - alertness (1-in-6 surprise), animal handling (20 percent nonproficient), animal lore (the 4-or-less/5-or-more failure split), blind-fighting (the halved penalties), boating, charioteering, direction sense (+4/+2 darkness, the 90-degree error), endurance, fire-building, fishing, foraging, healing (the emergency 1d3, the poison +2 package, the disease step-down), hunting (the party ladder 1/3/6/10/15), mountaineering, plant lore, the riding feats (airborne and land-based), rope use (+3/+6 escape), running (the sprint and distance packages), the survival trio (the 20-degree shifts), swimming, tracking (5 per level plus 5, capped 55) and weather sense (the six-hour read).

banner.title: The WSG PROFICIENCIES PROSE, R498: the chapter frame and the twenty-five descriptions, printed pp. 11-17 (pdf 12-18). The Table 1/2 grids and the check/improving/expanding system stay with R425 (rules/wsgprof.h) as seams; this round pins the prose around and between them - every description mechanic from the 1-in-6 alertness surprise to the weather sense lockout.
banner.provenance: WSG printed pp. 11-17, pdf 12-18, extracted at r497-extraction sha 0d5f109 (tesseract full-text and tsv, x12-x18, 300 dpi) - the same pass as R497. The tesseract Table 2 read dropped rows but the grid is already pinned by R425 from the IIIF image; the descriptions prose read whole and clean.
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: the last four WSG boxes flip in the same commit; the gap report lands at 186 closed / 0 open - THE ENTIRE WILDERNESS SURVIVAL GUIDE IS PINNED; census 422 -> 423.

consts.name: wpdDescriptionCount
consts.comment: twenty-five proficiency descriptions, alertness through weather sense - matching the twenty-five Table 2 rows pinned by R425.

consts.name: wpdAlertSurpriseReductionIn6
consts.comment: a successful alertness check reduces the surprise chance by 1 in 6, for the character and for any party members he can communicate with.

consts.name: wpdAnimalHandlingNonprofPct
consts.comment: a character without animal handling has only a 20 percent chance of calming an excited animal (the R490 seam).

consts.name: wpdAnimalLoreNoInfoFailBy
consts.comment: an animal lore check failed by 4 or less yields no information.

consts.name: wpdAnimalLoreWrongInfoFailBy
consts.comment: an animal lore check failed by 5 or more yields incorrect information.

consts.name: wpdBlindTotalDarkPen
consts.comment: blind-fighting: the total-darkness attack and damage penalty is only -2 (instead of -4).

consts.name: wpdBlindTotalDarkBasePen
consts.comment: the total-darkness penalty without blind-fighting.

consts.name: wpdBlindNaturalDarkPen
consts.comment: blind-fighting: the natural-darkness penalty is only -1 (instead of -3).

consts.name: wpdBlindNaturalDarkBasePen
consts.comment: the natural-darkness penalty without blind-fighting.

consts.name: wpdDirSenseTotalDarkMod
consts.comment: a direction sense check in total darkness takes a +4 modifier.

consts.name: wpdDirSensePartialDarkMod
consts.comment: a direction sense check in partial darkness takes a +2 modifier.

consts.name: wpdDirSenseErrorDeg
consts.comment: a failed direction sense check (under 20) errs by 90 degrees left or right, at the DM decision.

consts.name: wpdEnduranceStrenuousMult
consts.comment: endurance doubles the time of continual strenuous activity before fatigue and exhaustion apply.

consts.name: wpdHealingEmergencyDie
consts.comment: emergency healing restores 1d3 hit points.

consts.name: wpdHealingWindowRounds
consts.comment: emergency healing must begin within one round of the wound.

consts.name: wpdHealingTravelHpPerDay
consts.comment: continuous care restores 1 hit point per day even while traveling.

consts.name: wpdHealingRestHpPerDay
consts.comment: continuous care with rest restores 2 hit points per day.

consts.name: wpdHealingPoisonSaveBonus
consts.comment: healing aid in the poison round grants a +2 saving throw bonus versus poison.

consts.name: wpdHealingPoisonRestTurns
consts.comment: the poison victim must rest one full turn to keep the saving throw bonus.

consts.name: wpdHealingPoisonAidRounds
consts.comment: the healer must aid the poison victim for at least five rounds after the poisoning round.

consts.name: wpdHealingDiseaseWindowTurns
consts.comment: disease aid must begin within three turns of the onset of symptoms.

consts.name: wpdHealingAidPerDay
consts.comment: the diseased character needs aid from the healer twice per day at regular intervals.

consts.name: wpdHealingMissRevertConsecutive
consts.comment: two consecutive missed medicine sessions revert the disease to its original severity.

consts.name: wpdHealingMissRevertTotal
consts.comment: three total missed medicine sessions also revert the disease.

consts.name: wpdHuntPartyMod1
consts.comment: hunting with one extra character: +1 to the check.

consts.name: wpdHuntPartyMod2
consts.comment: hunting with two extra characters: +3.

consts.name: wpdHuntPartyMod3
consts.comment: hunting with three extra characters: +6.

consts.name: wpdHuntPartyMod4
consts.comment: hunting with four extra characters: +10.

consts.name: wpdHuntPartyMod5
consts.comment: hunting with five extra characters: +15.

consts.name: wpdHuntAutoFailPartySize
consts.comment: a hunting party of six or more besides the hunter fails the check automatically - no roll needed.

consts.name: wpdAirborneDropMaxFt
consts.comment: airborne riding: a rider can drop onto his mount from no more than 10 feet above it.

consts.name: wpdAirborneSpurRateIn
consts.comment: airborne riding: spurring adds 1 inch to the flying movement rate.

consts.name: wpdAirborneSpurMaxTurns
consts.comment: the spur lasts at most four consecutive turns.

consts.name: wpdAirborneSpurFailWaitTurns
consts.comment: after a failed initial spur check, no retry for at least three turns.

consts.name: wpdAirborneSpurFatigueNum
consts.comment: a fatigued mount slows to 2/3 of its normal maximum rate (numerator).

consts.name: wpdAirborneSpurFatigueDen
consts.comment: the fatigued mount fraction denominator.

consts.name: wpdAirborneSpurRestTurns
consts.comment: the fatigued mount must land and rest at least two turns.

consts.name: wpdAirborneMCFatigueDrop
consts.comment: the fatigued mount performs as if one Maneuverability Class worse.

consts.name: wpdDropMeleeFt
consts.comment: the hover-drop feat: leap from 10 feet or less and melee anyone within 10 feet of the landing.

consts.name: wpdDropMod
consts.comment: the hover-drop check takes a +4 modifier.

consts.name: wpdDropFailDmgDie
consts.comment: a failed hover-drop causes 1d3 points of damage.

consts.name: wpdDropFailACPen
consts.comment: a failed hover-drop leaves a -4 armor class penalty for the round.

consts.name: wpdLandJumpNoCheckObstacleFt
consts.comment: land-based riding: no check needed below a 3-foot obstacle.

consts.name: wpdLandJumpNoCheckGapFt
consts.comment: no check needed below a 12-foot gap.

consts.name: wpdLandJumpMaxObstacleFt
consts.comment: a successful check urges the mount up to 7-foot obstacles.

consts.name: wpdLandJumpMaxGapFt
consts.comment: a successful check clears gaps up to 30 feet wide.

consts.name: wpdLandSpurRateIn
consts.comment: land-based spurring adds 1 inch per round.

consts.name: wpdLandSpurMaxTurns
consts.comment: land-based spurring lasts up to four turns.

consts.name: wpdLandSpurFailWaitTurns
consts.comment: after a failed initial land spur check, no retry for three turns.

consts.name: wpdLandSpurFailWalkTurns
consts.comment: a failed second land spur check: the rider must dismount and lead the animal for a turn.

consts.name: wpdLandKneesFailExtraDie
consts.comment: failing the knees-guidance damage check causes a fall with 1d6 extra points of damage.

consts.name: wpdLandShieldACSteps
consts.comment: the shielded position grants 6 armor class steps (10 becomes 4, 8 becomes 2).

consts.name: wpdLandDropRiseSegsLo
consts.comment: a failed land hover-drop leaves the rider on the ground for 1-3 segments (low).

consts.name: wpdLandDropRiseSegsHi
consts.comment: the rise-segment high bound.

consts.name: wpdLandDropVulnerableHitMod
consts.comment: an attack on the still-grounded rider is made at +2 to hit.

consts.name: wpdRopeEscapeFrontMod
consts.comment: escaping rope bonds with hands tied in front: +3 to the check.

consts.name: wpdRopeEscapeBehindMod
consts.comment: hands tied behind the back: +6 to the check.

consts.name: wpdRopeLassoHitMod
consts.comment: rope use grants +2 to hit with a lasso.

consts.name: wpdRopeClimbBonusPct
consts.comment: rope use grants a 10 percent bonus on climbing checks with a rope.

consts.name: wpdRunSprintMult
consts.comment: sprinting: twice the normal maximum movement rate.

consts.name: wpdRunSprintRounds
consts.comment: the sprint lasts five rounds.

consts.name: wpdRunSprintAltNum
consts.comment: the alternative sprint: one and one-half times normal (3/2, rounded up).

consts.name: wpdRunSprintAltDen
consts.comment: the alternative sprint denominator.

consts.name: wpdRunSprintAltTurns
consts.comment: the alternative sprint lasts one turn.

consts.name: wpdRunSprintExtModPerRound
consts.comment: extended sprinting: each check after the first takes a cumulative +3 (+3, +6, +9...).

consts.name: wpdRunStopFreshAgainTurns
consts.comment: stopping a sprint before fatigue: normal rate for two turns, then sprint again.

consts.name: wpdRunHalfSpeedAgainTurns
consts.comment: at half the normal rate, sprint again after one turn.

consts.name: wpdRunRestExampleExertTurns
consts.comment: distance running: eight turns of exertion are offset by one turn of rest.

consts.name: wpdRunCheckEveryTurns
consts.comment: twelve turns of long-distance running require a Constitution check.

consts.name: wpdRunCheckNextAfterTurns
consts.comment: a successful check covers ten more turns before the next one.

consts.name: wpdSurvColdEffShift
consts.comment: cold survival: the effective temperature reads 20 degrees warmer.

consts.name: wpdSurvColdAppliesAtOrBelow
consts.comment: cold survival applies only at effective temperatures of 30 degrees or lower.

consts.name: wpdSurvHeatEffShift
consts.comment: heat survival: the effective temperature reads 20 degrees cooler.

consts.name: wpdSurvHeatAppliesAtOrAbove
consts.comment: heat survival applies only at effective temperatures of 80 degrees or higher.

consts.name: wpdTrackBasePctPerLevel
consts.comment: tracking: 5 percent per level of the character.

consts.name: wpdTrackBaseBonusPct
consts.comment: tracking: plus an additional 5 percent.

consts.name: wpdTrackMaxPct
consts.comment: the tracking chance caps at 55 percent - half the ranger base (the UA p. 21 seam).

consts.name: wpdWeatherSenseHours
consts.comment: weather sense reads the coming six hours.

consts.name: wpdWeatherSenseFreePerDay
consts.comment: the first weather sense attempt each day is free.

consts.name: wpdWeatherSenseRepeatMod
consts.comment: each attempt beyond the first takes a cumulative +2.

consts.name: wpdWeatherSenseFailLockoutHours
consts.comment: a failed weather sense check auto-fails every check in the next 12 hours.

bools.name: wpdSystemMatchesDSG
bools.comment: the wilderness proficiency system is essentially the same as the Dungeoneer Survival Guide nonweapon system (the R425 seam).

bools.name: wpdDualEnvironmentShared
bools.comment: proficiencies shared with DSG (fire-building, land-based riding) work in both underground and above-ground environments.

bools.name: wpdUndergroundOnlyExists
bools.comment: some proficiencies are underground-only by nature: fungus identification is the DSG example.

bools.name: wpdPlantLoreWildernessOnly
bools.comment: plant lore is useful only in the wilderness.

bools.name: wpdSelectionPlayerChooses
bools.comment: the selection of nonweapon proficiencies is basically up to the player.

bools.name: wpdBackgroundLogicRule
bools.comment: players should respect character background: no desert survival without desert time, no swimming skill for a desert-raised character.

bools.name: wpdLevelingStillLogical
bools.comment: advancement selections follow the same logic: no desert survival until sizable desert time.

bools.name: wpdDirectionSenseEasyJustify
bools.comment: direction sense is justifiable for practically any character at any time - an inborn knack or between-levels training.

bools.name: wpdDMApprovalRequired
bools.comment: all selections are subject to DM approval; an illogical pick may - must - be disallowed.

bools.name: wpdDelayAllowedNotDuringAdventure
bools.comment: a delayed slot fill is allowed but should never be filled during an adventure - no sudden swimming in a lake.

bools.name: wpdAnimalHandlingCalmsOnCheck
bools.comment: a successful animal handling check calms an excited or agitated animal.

bools.name: wpdBlindNoACPenalty
bools.comment: blind-fighting grants no armor class penalty from darkness.

bools.name: wpdBlindRetainsAbilities
bools.comment: blind-fighting keeps special abilities and other proficiencies usable in darkness.

bools.name: wpdBlindAdverseChanceHalf
bools.comment: blind-fighting halves the chance of stumbling, tumbling into pits or over cliffs, and slipping while climbing.

bools.name: wpdBlindShortRangeOnly
bools.comment: blind-fighting is short-range only: no long-distance vision, tracking-scale sight excluded.

bools.name: wpdBoatingFastestRate
bools.comment: a boating-proficient pilot moves the vessel at its fastest possible rate (the R457 seam).

bools.name: wpdBoatingReducesCapsize
bools.comment: the boating proficiency reduces the capsize chance in rough water or high winds.

bools.name: wpdCharioteerFasterRate
bools.comment: charioteering moves a chariot at one-third faster than the normal rate over negotiable terrain.

bools.name: wpdCharioteerNoImpossibleTerrain
bools.comment: charioteering never moves a chariot over terrain it cannot traverse - no chariots into the mountains.

bools.name: wpdDirSenseSecretRoll
bools.comment: the direction sense check is always rolled by the DM in secret.

bools.name: wpdDirSenseNatural20Opposite
bools.comment: a direction sense roll of 20 means the exact opposite direction.

bools.name: wpdDirSenseMultiChecker
bools.comment: with multiple direction-sense characters the DM checks for each; agreeing characters may both be right - or both wrong the same way.

bools.name: wpdEnduranceNoFoodWaterExtension
bools.comment: endurance never extends the time a character can go without food or water.

bools.name: wpdFireBuildNoFlintOnCheck
bools.comment: a successful fire-building check starts a fire without flint, steel or a tinderbox.

bools.name: wpdFireBuildHalfTimeWithKit
bools.comment: with proper equipment the fire-building proficient character takes half the normal time.

bools.name: wpdFishingBetterCatch
bools.comment: the fishing proficiency improves the catch - the R465 seam.

bools.name: wpdForagingTwiceOrHalfTime
bools.comment: foraging yields twice the food in the same time, or the same food in half the time (the R463 seam).

bools.name: wpdHealingCapAtWound
bools.comment: emergency healing never restores more than the wound caused in the preceding round.

bools.name: wpdHealingOnePatientPerDay
bools.comment: the continuous-care benefit applies to only one character per day.

bools.name: wpdHealingContinuousNoCheck
bools.comment: the continuous-care recovery needs no Proficiency Check, only that healer and patient share a group.

bools.name: wpdHealingPoisonNoCheckNeeded
bools.comment: the poison saving throw bonus needs no check, only the same-round start, the one-turn rest and the five rounds of aid.

bools.name: wpdHealingPoisonMissResaves
bools.comment: missing either time requirement forces a fresh poison saving throw with no bonus.

bools.name: wpdHealingDiseaseStepDown
bools.comment: a successful disease check lowers the severity one step: terminal to severe, severe to mild.

bools.name: wpdHealingMildHalfDuration
bools.comment: an already-mild disease runs its course in half the time under healing care.

bools.name: wpdHuntPenaltyEvenWithProficients
bools.comment: the hunting party penalty applies even when the extra characters have hunting proficiency themselves.

bools.name: wpdMountaineerUsesSpikes
bools.comment: mountaineering ascends unclimbable rock by driving spikes into cracks (the R446 seam).

bools.name: wpdPlantLoreNoMisidentify
bools.comment: a successful plant lore check guarantees the medicinal plant is the correct sort (the R479 seam).

bools.name: wpdAirbornePerCategorySelection
bools.comment: airborne riding is selected per flying-mount category and may be taken more than once.

bools.name: wpdAirborneDropArmorBar
bools.comment: the airborne drop feat fails in armor heavier than leather - falling damage and a panicked mount.

bools.name: wpdAirborneSameSegmentAirborneCheck
bools.comment: getting the mount airborne in the same segment as the landing requires a successful check.

bools.name: wpdAirborneHoverDropCheck
bools.comment: dropping onto a hovering mount requires a successful check.

bools.name: wpdAirborneSpurCheckEachTurn
bools.comment: the spur requires a check at the beginning of each turn.

bools.name: wpdAirborneSpurFourTurnsFatigue
bools.comment: four consecutive successful spur turns also slow and degrade the mount until it lands and rests.

bools.name: wpdAirborneKneesHandsFree
bools.comment: the knees-guidance feat leaves the hands free; damage forces a check.

bools.name: wpdLandVaultStillNoCheck
bools.comment: vaulting onto a still mount needs no check, even in armor.

bools.name: wpdLandVaultMovingCheck
bools.comment: vaulting onto a moving mount requires a check; failure is a harmless fall.

bools.name: wpdLandJumpBalkOnFail
bools.comment: a failed jump check balks the mount, forcing a keep-your-seat check.

bools.name: wpdLandSpurCheckEachTurn
bools.comment: the land spur requires a check at the beginning of each turn.

bools.name: wpdLandSpurAfterRaceWalk
bools.comment: after four turns of racing the steed must be walked by its dismounted rider for a turn.

bools.name: wpdLandKneesDamageCheck
bools.comment: knees-guidance needs a check only on taking damage; failure means a fall.

bools.name: wpdLandShieldLeatherOnly
bools.comment: the shielded position requires armor no heavier than leather.

bools.name: wpdLandShieldNoAttacks
bools.comment: the shielded position allows no attacks while it lasts.

bools.name: wpdLandShieldMountTakesHits
bools.comment: attacks that would have struck the shielded rider hit the mount instead.

bools.name: wpdLandShieldFullSpeed
bools.comment: the shielded position works even at full mount speed, with no check.

bools.name: wpdRopeShelterHalfTime
bools.comment: rope use erects or takes down a rope shelter in half the time.

bools.name: wpdRopeShelterHalfWeather
bools.comment: a rope-user shelter is half as likely to suffer from inclement weather.

bools.name: wpdRopeClimbBonusIncludesBelay
bools.comment: the climbing bonus includes belaying companions (the R440/R443 seam).

bools.name: wpdRunSprintEncumbranceBar
bools.comment: sprinting requires no encumbrance and armor no heavier than leather.

bools.name: wpdRunSprintOneFailedIsFatigue
bools.comment: one failed extended-sprint check fatigues the character; a second failure exhausts.

bools.name: wpdRunStopFatigueStays
bools.comment: stopping a sprint while fatigued keeps the fatigue; exhaustion forces an immediate stop.

bools.name: wpdRunDistanceFatigueFavors
bools.comment: distance running doubles or halves every fatigue time limit in favor of the character.

bools.name: wpdRunDistanceNoMidRunStrenuous
bools.comment: any other strenuous activity mid-run negates the distance benefits and restarts the standard clock.

bools.name: wpdSurvDesertWaterHoleDoubled
bools.comment: desert survival doubles the daily water-hole location chance.

bools.name: wpdSurvDesertForageHalfTime
bools.comment: desert survival locates a quantity of edible plants in half the normal time.

bools.name: wpdSurvDesertConserveSupply
bools.comment: desert survival conserves the water supply - longer stretchs between finds, not longer without water.

bools.name: wpdSwimCannotWithoutProf
bools.comment: a character without swimming proficiency cannot swim at all - the R450 seam.

bools.name: wpdSwimHoldBreathStillWorks
bools.comment: the nonproficient can still hold breath and float in the right circumstances.

bools.name: wpdTrackNonprofZeroBase
bools.comment: a nonproficient tracker has a 0 percent base chance, salvageable only by positive modifiers.

bools.name: wpdWeatherSenseSecretRoll
bools.comment: the DM always rolls weather sense checks and need not reveal the result.

bools.name: wpdWeatherSenseGeneralFact
bools.comment: a successful weather sense check yields at least one generally true fact about the coming six hours.

bools.name: wpdWeatherSenseFailQuietOrWrong
bools.comment: a failed weather sense check yields nothing, or at the DM discretion something incorrect.

bools.name: wpdWeatherSenseObviousNoCheck
bools.comment: obvious impending weather gets no check - the DM just describes what anyone can see.
